affectedPublicSurfaces: no public surface changes in this slice; it adds the harness that will gate demo.app-juli.com, app-juli.com, and api.app-juli.com releases from #838 onward

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: local fixture server plus an operator-supplied base URL; the harness is runnable against local dev, a candidate instance, or current production, and this slice exercises only the first

journeys.name: healthy-page-passes
journeys.entryUrl: local fixture: a page whose referenced stylesheets and scripts all resolve
assertions: every referenced stylesheet and script is fetched and asserted 2xx
each asset body is asserted non-trivial, so an empty or HTML-error response served in place of a stylesheet fails

journeys.name: broken-page-fails
journeys.entryUrl: local fixture: a page referencing a stylesheet that 404s, and one served as an HTML error body
assertions: the specific failing asset URL is named in output
a 200 response carrying an error page in place of CSS is rejected on body size, not accepted on status

journeys.name: core-api-paths
assertions: core API paths are asserted on response shape, not only status
a healthy process with a broken route fails the harness

migrationCompatibility.notes: The slice adds a verification script and its tests. It touches no database, queue, or persistence surface.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: revert the commit; the harness is not yet wired into any deploy path in this slice, so removing it restores the prior behaviour exactly

doNotInfer: wiring the harness into deploy-demo-release.sh or any cutover path — that is #838
browser-level computed-styling or interactivity assertions — those run in CI against the artifact per #837, and the split is deliberate
VPS-specific assumptions; the harness must run against an arbitrary base URL
nginx, systemd, slot, or traffic-switch changes
